name: libpeek-repo
description: libpeek - read npm package source without installing. Skill repo; zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.lint: for f in skills/libpeek/scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.smoke: node skills/libpeek/scripts/index.mjs list react && node skills/libpeek/scripts/index.mjs glob zod package.json && node skills/libpeek/scripts/index.mjs read react package.json && node skills/libpeek/scripts/index.mjs grep '{"package":"zod","pattern":"exports","include":"package.json"}'
